entities.name: Osteitis pubis
observations: Athlete-oriented PubMed search identified contemporary review literature on osteitis pubis; clinically, pubic symphysis tenderness with exertional groin/pubic pain and pain on resisted adduction supports this diagnosis over hip impingement or abdominal-wall causes.

entities.name: Pubic pain with resisted adduction
observations: In a marathon runner, exertional groin/pubic pain, symphyseal and pubic ramus tenderness, and pain with resisted adduction, with negative FADIR and resisted sit-up, favors osteitis pubis.
